nodes.label: Interruptibility (animate from presentation value)
nodes.rationale: Users think and gesture in parallel; locking input during a transition or starting from the target value causes jumps.

nodes.label: Springs with damping ratio + response
nodes.rationale: Springs are interruptible and velocity-aware; damping 1.0 default, ~0.8 only when the gesture carried momentum.

nodes.label: CSS transitions over keyframes for interruptible UI
nodes.norm_label: css transitions over keyframes for interruptible ui

nodes.label: Environment worst cases (320px, zoom, dark, RTL, touch)
nodes.norm_label: environment worst cases (320px, zoom, dark, rtl, touch)

nodes.label: Picker behavior contract (keys 1-N, arrows, R, ?v= param)
nodes.norm_label: picker behavior contract (keys 1-n, arrows, r, ?v= param)

nodes.label: Prototype Picker spec
nodes.rationale: Picker is harness chrome, copied verbatim and not theme-aware, so it never reads as part of the design being judged.

nodes.label: Plausible or schema-backed worst-case data
nodes.rationale: Nonsense data gets dismissed; realistic values prove the break. Change the data, not the component.

nodes.label: Animation Decision Framework
nodes.rationale: Frequency decides whether to animate; purpose, ease-out easing, and sub-300ms durations follow.

nodes.label: Variants diverge on a named axis
nodes.norm_label: variants diverge on a named axis
nodes.rationale: Three tints of the same idea teach nothing; each variant must be a shippable distinct direction.

nodes.label: Gate hover with (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)
nodes.norm_label: gate hover with (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)

nodes.label: Test on real hardware
nodes.rationale: Sticky hover, tap delay, safe areas, keyboard, and vh bugs don't reproduce in device emulation.

nodes.label: touch-action for tap delay and gesture axes
nodes.norm_label: touch-action for tap delay and gesture axes

nodes.label: Layout / paint / composite property tiers
nodes.rationale: transform/opacity skip layout and paint; swap down a tier (scale for width, translate for top, drop-shadow for box-shadow).

nodes.label: Socratic re-derivation of design decisions
nodes.rationale: User designs from the bare problem; tutor adds constraints and never reveals the decision.

nodes.label: Main thread vs hardware-accelerated drivers
nodes.rationale: rAF competes with page work; CSS/WAAPI can run off main thread. Vercel tab indicator fixed by moving to CSS animation.

nodes.label: Feel debugging (slow motion, frame-by-frame, real device, fresh eyes)
nodes.norm_label: feel debugging (slow motion, frame-by-frame, real device, fresh eyes)

nodes.label: Removal hazards
nodes.rationale: Hidden opacity:0 start states, transitionend waits, AnimatePresence exit timing, layout jumps, focus timing, tests.

nodes.label: Keep motion on the UI runtime
nodes.norm_label: keep motion on the ui runtime
nodes.rationale: No setState from gesture/scroll handlers, no scheduleOnRN per frame, .get()/.set() for React Compiler; RN-runtime motion stutters when the app is busy.

nodes.label: Motion effect glossary
nodes.rationale: Curated snapshot mirroring the project's /vocabulary page; quote verbatim and disambiguate close terms.

nodes.label: Never scale(0); start at scale(0.9-0.97) + opacity 0
nodes.norm_label: never scale(0); start at scale(0.9-0.97) + opacity 0

nodes.label: PressableScale component
nodes.rationale: 120ms, 3% scale CSS transition is the ceiling for something touched tens of times a day; no shared value needed.

nodes.label: Hold to confirm recipe
nodes.rationale: clip-path overlay, 2s linear on press, 200ms ease-out on release; linear because the fill is progress.

nodes.label: Collapsing header on scroll recipe
nodes.rationale: Never animate header height (layout pass per scroll frame); translate content in a fixed-height clipped container and clamp extrapolation.

nodes.label: Keyboard-synced UI recipe
nodes.rationale: Keyboard rides a private system curve; drive UI from react-native-keyboard-controller frame by frame, never Keyboard.addListener plus timing.

nodes.label: Self-contained plan for zero-context executor
nodes.rationale: Executor may be a less capable model with zero context and taste; inline every value, cite file:line, include feel check.

nodes.label: Recon / audit / vet / plan workflow
nodes.rationale: Capable model does judgment (audit, spec); execution handed to cheaper agents.

nodes.label: Curated library list (base-ui, cmdk, motion, recharts, Virtuoso, zustand...)
nodes.norm_label: curated library list (base-ui, cmdk, motion, recharts, virtuoso, zustand...)
nodes.rationale: Deliberate taste-driven picks; recommend one library, prefer what's already installed.

nodes.label: Sonner styling escalation ladder
nodes.rationale: Defaults -> inline -> classNames with !important -> headless toast.custom; headless recommended for design-system toasts.

nodes.label: Smoke Test Page (deliberately flawed UI)
nodes.rationale: Low contrast text, missing img alt, 20px icon button, unlabeled input, heavy shadow so audits have findings.

nodes.label: Smoke test checks (doctor, humanizer, impeccable, chrome-devtools, browser, connectors)
nodes.norm_label: smoke test checks (doctor, humanizer, impeccable, chrome-devtools, browser, connectors)
nodes.rationale: Never perform outward-facing actions during the smoke test.

nodes.label: Swift progressive disclosure / hierarchy of defaults
nodes.norm_label: swift progressive disclosure / hierarchy of defaults
nodes.rationale: Start static and single-threaded; buy concurrency, references, existentials, unsafe only with a stated reason.

nodes.label: project() momentum projection worklet
nodes.rationale: Apple exponential-decay form decides where a flick was going, so a fast short swipe commits and a slow long one does not.

nodes.label: Bottom sheet drag-to-dismiss recipe
nodes.rationale: onStart captures current value, velocity (not distance) decides, velocity handed to spring, overshootClamping on dismissal; prefer formSheet when the sheet is its own screen.

nodes.label: Swipe to delete row recipe
nodes.rationale: activeOffsetX must declare the axis or the pan steals vertical scrolls; use ReanimatedSwipeable for reveal-action rows.

nodes.label: Haptics rules (same frame, one per action, never only feedback)
nodes.norm_label: haptics rules (same frame, one per action, never only feedback)

nodes.label: Native stack screen transitions (Expo Router)
nodes.rationale: Never hand-roll screen transitions; native keeps back gesture and platform consistency. Tabs never slide.

nodes.label: Drag to dismiss recipe (web)
nodes.rationale: Velocity > 0.11 dismisses; set transform directly; pointer capture, multi-touch protection, damping past boundaries, friction not a wall.

nodes.label: Inherited CSS variable recalculation trap
nodes.rationale: Vaul drag lagged past ~20 items because --swipe-amount on parent recalculated every descendant; set transform directly.

nodes.label: Invocation variants (quick, deep, plan, execute, reconcile)
nodes.norm_label: invocation variants (quick, deep, plan, execute, reconcile)

nodes.label: Reduced motion: fewer and gentler, not zero
nodes.norm_label: reduced motion: fewer and gentler, not zero

nodes.label: Animation build sequence
nodes.rationale: Ordered decisions: should it animate, purpose, cheapest tool, properties, easing/duration or spring, interruption/exit, reduced motion and pointer gating.

nodes.label: Cheapest tool ladder (CSS transition to Motion)
nodes.norm_label: cheapest tool ladder (css transition to motion)

nodes.label: Removal gate decision tree
nodes.rationale: Burden of proof reversed: keyboard, 100+/day, functional data are deleted; unnamed purpose deleted unless rare delight.

nodes.label: Remedial preference hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Delete first, then reduce, fix easing, origin, interruptibility, GPU, asymmetry, polish, a11y.

nodes.label: Should it animate? frequency table
nodes.rationale: 100+/day and keyboard actions never animate (Raycast); tens/day reduced; occasional standard; rare earns delight.
